index.definition:
CREATE INDEX listings_public_global_rank_idx ON zoi.listings USING btree (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(name, ''::text))), lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(city, ''::text))), lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(zoi.geo_country_canon(country), ''::text))), ((verification_status = 'verified'::text)) DESC, trust_score DESC NULLS LAST, (
CASE entity_type
    WHEN 'creator'::text THEN 0
    WHEN 'artist'::text THEN 1
    WHEN 'business'::text THEN 2
    ELSE 3
END), name, id) INCLUDE (verification_status, entity_type, city, country) WHERE ((publish_status = 'published'::text) AND (moderation_status = ANY (ARRAY['clean'::text, 'cleared'::text])) AND (COALESCE(marketplace_status, ''::text) <> 'hidden'::text))
